name: Overdamage
teaser: Multiplies the overdamage to limbs by a customizable factor.
description_html:
Why use this mod?

Do you ever run a pump shotgun and shoot someone 3 times in a row with magnum buckshot and they are still kicking? Then this mod “alleviates” that issue by increasing the damage all the other limbs take on hit.

This mod affects the overdamage to the legs, arms and stomach.

The config contains 5 tweakable values:

enabled: (true or false) # Whether the mod is actually going to do anything. logBalancingWarnings: (true or false) # Log a message if you set the overdamage factor to untested values. multiplierHands: (any number) # Multiplies the hands overdamage values by this factor. multiplierLegs: (any number) # Multiplies the legs overdamage values by this factor. multiplierStomach: (any number) # Multiplies the stomach overdamage values by this factor.
